Option 1 — In the app (easiest)
Open PeakEnergyBiometrics
Click Punches
Pick a day → Load punches
You’ll see: Date, Time, Employee No (ID), Name, Direction, Device, Auth type
Filter with Employee No (e.g. ID101)
That reads live from atteninfo.

For hours only: Dashboard → Month or Day tab.

Option 2 — SQL (SSMS)
Connect to the ACS/SQL server (localhost if you are on that machine), database master.

Latest punches

SELECT TOP 50
    ID,
    personname,
    firstname,
    lastname,
    [datetime],
    [date],
    [time],
    direction,
    device,
    deviceno,
    readername,
    cardno,
    authenticationtype,
    authenticationresult
FROM dbo.atteninfo
ORDER BY [datetime] DESC;
One employee

SELECT
    ID,
    personname,
    [datetime],
    [date],
    [time],
    direction,
    device
FROM dbo.atteninfo
WHERE ID = 'ID101'
ORDER BY [datetime] DESC;
All distinct employee IDs in punches

SELECT DISTINCT ID, MAX(personname) AS personname
FROM dbo.atteninfo
GROUP BY ID
ORDER BY ID;
Direction reminder

direction	Meaning
1
Entry
2
Exit
Option 3 — Compare with Employees table
SELECT
    a.ID AS PunchID,
    e.EmployeeNo,
    e.Name AS EmployeeName,
    a.personname AS PunchName,
    a.[datetime],
    a.direction,
    a.device
FROM dbo.atteninfo a
LEFT JOIN dbo.Employees e ON e.EmployeeNo = a.ID
WHERE a.ID = 'ID101'
ORDER BY a.[datetime] DESC;
If EmployeeNo is NULL, that punch ID is not in the Employees table (or the strings don’t match).

Tip: If Punches shows nothing for today, try yesterday, or wait for the collector / do Run collector now (only if Enable punch collector is ON).
